//: The TypeScript baseline an Uplink author builds against. Shipped in the sdk tarball and exported as `@ksp-gonogo/sitrep-sdk/tsconfig.base.json`, so an Uplink that leaves this repo keeps compiling with the same settings the first-party ones use. `packages/core/src/uplink-tsconfig-parity.test.ts` holds it identical to the repo's own `tsconfig.base.json`.
